name: Build and Send a Block Kit Message
description: Configure custom blocks and send to a channel, group, or user. [See the documentation](https://api.slack.com/tools/block-kit-builder).

configurable_props.name: conversation
configurable_props.label: Channel
configurable_props.description: Select a public or private channel, or a user or group

configurable_props.name: text
configurable_props.label: Notification Text
configurable_props.description: Optionally provide a string for Slack to display as the new message notification (if you do not provide this, notification will be blank).

configurable_props.name: as_user
configurable_props.label: Send as User
configurable_props.description: Optionally pass `true` to post the message as the authenticated user, instead of as a bot. Defaults to `false`.

configurable_props.name: post_at
configurable_props.label: Schedule message
configurable_props.description: Messages can only be scheduled up to 120 days in advance, and cannot be scheduled for the past. The datetime should be in ISO 8601 format. (Example: `2014-01-01T00:00:00Z`)

configurable_props.name: include_sent_via_pipedream_flag
configurable_props.label: Include link to Pipedream
configurable_props.description: Defaults to `true`, includes a link to Pipedream at the end of your Slack message.

configurable_props.name: customizeBotSettings
configurable_props.label: Customize Bot Settings
configurable_props.description: Customize the username and/or icon of the Bot

configurable_props.name: username
configurable_props.label: Bot Username
configurable_props.description: Optionally customize your bot's user name (default is `Pipedream`). Must be used in conjunction with `Send as User` set to false, otherwise ignored.

configurable_props.name: icon_emoji
configurable_props.label: Icon (emoji)
configurable_props.description: Optionally provide an emoji to use as the icon for this message. E.g., `:fire:` Overrides `icon_url`.  Must be used in conjunction with `Send as User` set to `false`, otherwise ignored.

configurable_props.name: icon_url
configurable_props.label: Icon (image URL)
configurable_props.description: Optionally provide an image URL to use as the icon for this message. Must be used in conjunction with `Send as User` set to `false`, otherwise ignored.

configurable_props.name: thread_ts
configurable_props.label: Message Timestamp
configurable_props.description: Provide another message's `ts` value to make this message a reply (e.g., if triggering on new Slack messages, enter `{{event.ts}}`). Avoid using a reply's `ts` value; use its parent instead. e.g. `1403051575.000407`.

configurable_props.name: thread_broadcast
configurable_props.label: Send Channel Message
configurable_props.description: If `true`, posts in the thread and channel. Used in conjunction with `Message Timestamp` and indicates whether reply should be made visible to everyone in the channel. Defaults to `false`.

configurable_props.name: addMessageMetadata
configurable_props.label: Add Message Metadata
configurable_props.description: Set the metadata event type and payload

configurable_props.name: metadata_event_type
configurable_props.label: Metadata Event Type
configurable_props.description: The name of the metadata event. Example: `task_created`

configurable_props.name: metadata_event_payload
configurable_props.label: Metadata Event Payload
configurable_props.description: The payload of the metadata event. Must be a JSON string. Example: `{ "id": "11223", "title": "Redesign Homepage"}`

configurable_props.name: configureUnfurlSettings
configurable_props.label: Configure Unfurl Settings
configurable_props.description: Configure settings for unfurling links and media

configurable_props.name: unfurl_links
configurable_props.label: Unfurl Links
configurable_props.description: Default to `false`. Pass `true` to enable unfurling of links.

configurable_props.name: unfurl_media
configurable_props.label: Unfurl Media
configurable_props.description: Defaults to `false`. Pass `true` to enable unfurling of media content.

configurable_props.name: passArrayOrConfigure
configurable_props.label: Add Blocks - Reference Existing Blocks Array or Configure Manually?
configurable_props.description: Would you like to reference an array of blocks from a previous step (for example, `{{steps.blocks.$return_value}}`), or configure them in this action?
